name: TideGS Trajectory Ordering
definition: A training strategy for 3D Gaussian Splatting that replaces standard randomized view shuffling with a trajectory-aware ordered sequence of views to improve optimization stability and convergence for large-scale scenes.
summary: TideGS Trajectory Ordering replaces randomized view shuffling with a clustered TSP sequence to improve optimization stability and convergence for large-scale 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes.
